description: This file declares structures, enums, and functions for SSL/TLS support in the hiredis Redis client, including context creation, initialization, and SSL handshake procedures.

methods.name: redisSSLContextGetError
methods.description: Returns error message string for a given SSL context error code.

methods.name: redisInitOpenSSL
methods.description: Initializes the OpenSSL library; should be called once before using SSL functions.

methods.name: redisCreateSSLContext
methods.description: Creates and initializes an SSL context with optional certificate and key files, CA certificates, and server name.

methods.name: redisInitiateSSLWithContext
methods.description: Performs SSL handshake on an existing redisContext using a specified SSL context.

methods.name: redisInitiateSSL
methods.description: Performs SSL handshake on a redisContext with a provided OpenSSL SSL object.
